source.note: Minimal genre-neutral reference acceptance template for the 3d-shooter SEED (first slice of the 3D-shooter genre). It exercises the required, genre-neutral contract sections (fonts/palette/hud/framing/feel/juice/manifest/win) for a single-player, non-Fusion 3D shooter and deliberately OMITS the optional platformer-only sections (platformer/reachability/placement/render/props/physics). The feel section carries ONLY the core shooter metrics that this seed gate-enforces today (fireIntervalMs, fireInputToSpawnLatency, ttkMs); additional 3D-shooter measurements (projectileSpeed, aimTurnRateDegPerSec, lookInputToYawLatencyMs, shotAimAlignmentDeg, hitstopMs, screenShakeMag, hitscanImpactLatencyMs, enemyReactionLatencyMs, coverBlocksDamage, waveObjectiveComplete, wallSlideTangentRatio) are measure-only proof capabilities unless a GenreContract promotes them with explicit gate bands. wallSlideTangentRatio (dogfood learnings §2 wall-slide feel gate, binds to deriveWallSlideTangentRatio) proves diagonal-into-wall input preserves tangent motion — relevant to strafing into cover/geometry — and the 3d-topdown-arena pack carries its default band. The 3C lookInputToYawLatencyMs + shotAimAlignmentDeg pair was promoted from a bridge gap to measurable-now with committed live evidence (demos/evidence-bundles/3d-shooter-3c-controller-camera). Recoil/ADS and broad aiming quality remain explicit gaps. This is a seed for `plan --genre 3d-shooter`, not a hand-tuned shipping contract, and not a 'production-ready 3D shooter' claim.

elements.note: Max 3 hearts; lost slot stays as an empty pip so layout never shifts.
Screen-center aim reticle; the 3C slice keeps the crosshair centered while look input rotates the player/camera aim.

camera.note: Single perspective rig framing a bounded 3D range. The seed fixture uses a third-person follow camera behind the player; the pack contract NAMES one perspective (third-person) per the extraction plan, and does not claim a 2D orthographic/pixel-art frame.

playerAnchor.note: Third-person follow — the player reads near screen-center horizontally. Informational; no per-frame follow assertion in the seed.

framing.note: 16:9 perspective range. Not a 2D pixel frame: no native-resolution / pixel-scale / orthographic-size claims.

fireIntervalMs.note: cadence between shots; measure-only, binds to the fireIntervalMs calculator (dimension-agnostic counter edges)

fireInputToSpawnLatency.note: fire input onset to projectile spawn; measure-only (aspirational target, not gate-enforced)

ttkMs.note: first-hit to reference-enemy death; measure-only, binds to the ttkMs calculator (hit/death edges)

hitStop.note: Design intent for a generated build — brief impact freeze on enemy hit/kill. The hit-stop WINDOW DURATION (hitstopMs) is now measurable in 3D and live-proven in the repo-owned fixture (demos/evidence-bundles/3d-impact-feedback/, deriveHitstopMs, causality-gated); this ms/frames target stays design intent, not a gate-enforced band. See methodology-gaps.md.

screenShake.note: Design intent for a generated build — small kick on fire, larger on hit/kill. The camera-DISPLACEMENT magnitude (screenShakeMag) is now measurable in true 3D and live-proven in the repo-owned fixture (demos/evidence-bundles/3d-impact-feedback/, deriveScreenShakeMag hypot(dx,dy,dz), Z load-bearing, causality-gated); this px/decay target stays design intent, not a gate-enforced band. See methodology-gaps.md.

win.note: Win when every reference enemy in the range is defeated; reaching a zero-enemy state flips the GameManager win flag.
